items.title: Adobe (ADBE) Is Printing Cash While Wall Street Writes Its Obituary
items.summary: Adobe (ADBE) is printing cash even as Wall Street writes off its prospects amid growing concerns about artificial intelligence (AI). Even after falling nearly 64% from its all-time high, the creative software giant continues to deliver double-digit revenue growth. It also generates more than $10 billion in annual free cash flow (FCF) and spends billions on share buybacks. Yet, at around $235, the stock trades at just 9x its annual FCF.
